operations.content: CodeMirror 6: `basicSetup` comes from the `codemirror` meta-package, NOT from individual `@codemirror/*` packages. When using CodeMirror in React/Vite projects, install BOTH: `codemirror` (for basicSetup) AND `@codemirror/view`, `@codemirror/state`, `@codemirror/lang-python`, `@codemirror/theme-one-dark`. Without the meta-package, the `basicSetup` import will fail.

FastAPI project structure: when backend is a package (backend/ with __init__.py), run uvicorn from project ROOT: `uvicorn backend.main:app --port 8000`. Do NOT `cd backend && uvicorn main:app` — that breaks `from backend.xxx` imports with ModuleNotFoundError.

When using `npm create vite@latest frontend -- --template react`, the resulting React version tracks latest (React 19+), not a pinned version. Plans should account for this. React 19 is backward-compatible for standard hooks/components.
